text: Figure 4.54: Examble for OutOfRangeBitfield Calculation [SWS_Rte_04675] Rte Generate a Macro for Out of Range Information ⌈A macro ( Rte_IsOutOfRange) to access the out of range check information shall be generated for each flattened ImplementationDataTypeElement of an Implementation- DataType where the attribute outOfRangeBitfieldErrorsEnabled is set true. The macro shall be generated in the Application T ypes Header File of each software component using this type. ⌋ The out of range bitfield can contain information of the out-of-range for the elements of sub-structures by using the flattened Structure. [SWS_Rte_04676] Returning the Invalid Value Details of Elements in Structure ⌈The RTE shall store invalid value errors in a bitfield for the flattened elements in the structure if the invalidValueBitfieldErrorsEnabled for the port mapped to the signal is set to TRUE and the handleInvalid has any value other than dontInval- idate.⌋ Note: It is not specifed by the RTE at which point in time the calcution of the invalid value bitfied happens and it is left to the implementer. Latest after Rte_Read or Rte_ Receive return the invalid value bitfied has to be valid. Example: If the Rte API Calls (e.g. Rte_Read) receives a structure of three elements as shown the following figure and the value of Element1 and Element2 are invalid, then the invalid value errors bitfield should have value 3 as shown the following figure.
